sub: 5 habits, with examples of what to say

steps.title: Be specific
points: Name the exact piece of work
Example: "Your summary was clear and short."
steps.tip: "Good job" feels nice but teaches nothing.

steps.title: Give it soon
points: Within a day or two of the task
A quick chat, not a long email
steps.tip: Feedback weeks later is hard to act on.

steps.title: Keep it balanced
points: Example: "Next time, put the dates at the top."
steps.tip: One clear change beats a list of five.

steps.title: Make it two-way
points: Ask how they think it went
steps.tip: Interns learn faster when they spot the fix themselves.

steps.title: Follow up
points: Notice when they make the change
steps.tip: Closing the loop shows the feedback mattered.

cta_sub: Try one of these habits this week.
post_title: How to Give an Intern Feedback: 5 Habits and Examples

captions.linkedin:
Good feedback is the fastest way an intern grows. 5 habits, with examples of what to say.

Be specific: "Your summary was clear and short."
Give it soon: "Got 5 minutes about this morning?"
Keep it balanced: one thing that worked, one thing to change
Make it two-way: "What would you do differently?"
Follow up: "That's much clearer. Nice work."
